description: Keycloak's Admin REST API manages realms, users, groups, clients, roles, sessions, and identity providers on an operator-hosted Keycloak deployment. Calls require a bearer access token with appropriate administrative roles or delegated permissions; the full realm-admin role is not required. Tokens may represent users or service accounts and can be obtained through supported OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect flows, including direct access grants and client credentials.
resolution_notes: description: CORRECTED. The current developer guide requires an access token with appropriate permissions and documents both user and service-account authentication; the administration guide documents narrower roles and delegated fine-grained permissions, proving realm-admin is not universally required. https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_development/index.html https://www.keycloak.org/docs/latest/server_admin/
